dc:title: Google review removal time: an observation-window sensitivity analysis
dc:description: Multiple countries and industries in the publisher description; no separate Canadian sample or merchant-report cohort.

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Reported aggregate with conditional mathematical columns; other tables explicitly identify synthetic examples.

columns.name: source_year_label
columns.dc:description: Original selected creation-year label, not removal year.

columns.name: count
columns.dc:description: Count in the selected source row, not all reviews created that year.

columns.name: median_lifespan_days
columns.dc:description: Publisher-reported median age among the selected deleted reviews; not merchant report-processing time.

columns.name: removed_within_30_days_percent
columns.dc:description: Publisher’s reported <=30-day measure for the selected deleted cohort; not the original-review population risk.

columns.name: conditional_lifespan_lower_days
columns.dc:description: Conditional calendar support lower bound in elapsed days. Interpret with lower_inclusive and the published timing assumption.

columns.name: conditional_lifespan_upper_days
columns.dc:description: Strict conditional calendar support upper bound; not a maximum observed lifespan or a service guarantee.

columns.name: endpoint_31_days
columns.dc:description: Model classification for <31 elapsed days; do not substitute for the separate reported <=30-day statistic.
